title: Data Snapshot numerical observations — provisional design
scope: Experimental numeric observations from tables, charts and infographics. Concepts adapted from WDI/ECOFIN indicators, OECD statistical operation, UNICEF population/demographic/geographic breakdowns, and SDG bounds/source detail; local extensions describe reporting roles and model results. All dimensions are uncoded strings, preserving source terminology. This is not a validated general DSD or a copy of any institutional DSD. Null keys mean unknown and serialize as local _UNKNOWN; local _NOT_APPLICABLE means a dimension does not apply. REPORTING_PERIOD deliberately retains source text as a string, not a normalized SDMX time dimension. Mixed record tables and geometry are outside this numeric draft. Missing distinctions must be reported, not squeezed into generic fields.

dimensions.name: Measured concept
dimensions.description: Source-supported outcome, indicator or measured concept, distinct from its statistical operation. Retain source wording.

dimensions.name: Category
dimensions.description: Primary substantive category, such as income sector, employment status, project component or guarantee system. Preserve source label. A total is its own explicit category. Do not concatenate several independent dimensions.

dimensions.name: Comparison group
dimensions.description: A separate comparison classification, such as HIGH versus LOW_MIDDLE income group. Do not repeat a population group here when POPULATION_GROUP already expresses it.

dimensions.name: Statistical operation
dimensions.description: Source-supported statistical form, such as Mean, Median, count, percentage, coefficient, standard error or sample size. Preserve source terminology; an unspecified Mean must not be upgraded to arithmetic or weighted mean.

dimensions.name: Population group
dimensions.description: Source population or beneficiary group, such as refugees, host community or Shona. Do not invent subgroup definitions or age thresholds.

dimensions.name: Sex breakdown
dimensions.description: Sex category explicitly shown in the source; do not interpret an absent breakdown as total population.

dimensions.name: Age breakdown
dimensions.description: Age group exactly as displayed. Do not assign numeric thresholds to Children, Adult or Elderly without visible evidence.

dimensions.name: Reference area
dimensions.description: Geographic area of this observation at the reported level. Do not infer country from directory, source agency or external knowledge.

dimensions.name: Source reporting period
dimensions.description: Source-visible period applying to the observation, retaining irregular intervals as printed. Not a normalized TIME_PERIOD, publication date, map scale, deadline or extraction date.

dimensions.name: Reporting role
dimensions.description: Source-supported distinction such as Baseline, Closing Period, Target, Planned, Actual, overall cost, financed subset, fitted or raw series. Do not call closing-period values achieved or target without evidence. If no such distinction applies use _NOT_APPLICABLE.

dimensions.name: Unit of measure
dimensions.description: Unit as supported by the source, such as persons, percent or US dollars. Preserve per-unit meaning. Unknown currency stays unknown; a bare number is not proof of a dimensionless measure.

dimensions.name: Model specification
dimensions.description: Visible model/column/specification identifier distinguishing statistical estimates; retain nested heading context. Not an invented dataset identifier.

dimensions.name: Model term
dimensions.description: Source regressor, coefficient term, lag or intercept for a model result. Model summary statistics may use _NOT_APPLICABLE here and identify the statistic in STATISTICAL_OPERATION.

attributes.name: Unit multiplier
attributes.description: Base-10 scale explicitly supported by the source, for example 6 for millions and 3 for thousands. Values remain on the printed scale. Leave null when not established.

attributes.name: Lower bound
attributes.description: Lower bound on the observation's displayed scale, only when recoverable and its association is clear. Do not invent omitted error bars.

attributes.name: Upper bound
attributes.description: Upper bound on the observation's displayed scale, only when recoverable and its association is clear.

attributes.name: Confidence level
attributes.description: Stated confidence level as a percentage, such as 95. Null for error bars whose confidence meaning is not specified.

attributes.name: Significance notation
attributes.description: Printed significance markers and their visible definition, if any; do not infer thresholds absent a legend.

attributes.name: Source observation status
attributes.description: Status stated by the source, such as provisional, estimated or projected. This differs from whether our extraction estimated a plotted value.

attributes.name: Interpretive source note
attributes.description: Visible note or explanation needed to interpret this observation, its denominator, bounds, cost coverage or model. Do not invent source text.
